issue_context.title: Casting an all null column created with pl.lit(None) with length greater than 1 to another type in the same with_columns or select context fails
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
assert (
    pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2]})
    .with_columns(pl.lit(None).cast(pl.List(pl.Int32)).alias("b"))
    .collect_schema()
    .dtypes()
) == [pl.Int64, pl.List(pl.Int32)]
```


### Log output

```shell
AssertionError
```


### Issue description

This creates a dtype of `pl.List(pl.Null)` for column `b` instead of the expected `pl.List(pl.Int32)`.

### Expected behavior

Expected the dtype of column `b` to be `pl.List(pl.Int32)`

### Installed versions

```

Index type:          UInt32
Platform:            Linux-6.8.0-40-generic-x86_64-with-glibc2.35
```
